import os, textwrap
from pathlib import Path
work=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace')
programs=work/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    # The connected multicolor object is the template; isolated points are targets.
    unseen = set(points)
    components = []
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = deque([start])
        while q:
            r, c = q.popleft()
            for p in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    q.append(p)
        components.append(comp)
    template = max(components, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in template)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in template)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in template)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in template)
    anchor = ((r0+r1)//2, (c0+c1)//2)
    offsets = [(r-anchor[0], c-anchor[1], grid[r][c]) for r,c in template]
    targets = points - template
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for tr, tc in targets:
        for dr, dc, color in offsets:
            r, c = tr+dr, tc+dc
            if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
